purpose: Accept a hypothetical premise without changing the main conclusion.
keywords: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveだ + としても
Even if we left now, we would not arrive in time.
Even if it is free, I will not take it if I do not need it.
Even if they oppose me, I want to explain my reasons.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjectiveだ + としても
restrictions: Means even assuming that; need not concede an established fact.
mistake: Unlike として, this is a concessive conditional.
